facts.name: Rocky Face (GNIS summit feature)
facts.what: USGS GNIS-cataloged summit feature named 'Rocky Face' in Alexander County, NC; shown on the Hiddenite USGS 7.5' topo quadrangle. NOTE: GNIS-listed coordinates differ from peak databases (see other facts) - GNIS often places a feature at a generalized point, not the true high point.
facts.access: Within Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area; reached by park trails

facts.name: Rocky Face summit (topozone waypoint)
facts.what: Summit point as listed by Topozone for Rocky Face, Alexander County (Hiddenite area); displayed on Hiddenite USGS topo map.
facts.access: Within/near Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area trail system

facts.name: Rocky Face peak (PeakVisor)
facts.what: Rocky Face peak entry in PeakVisor database; ranked #14 of 27 peaks in Alexander County by elevation and #6 of 27 by prominence. Prominence 607 ft (185 m). In NC Piedmont-Southeast Coast range. Coords corroborate the topozone summit waypoint (~35.972,-81.109).
facts.access: Within Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area

facts.name: Rocky Face Mountain (general description)
facts.what: Dome-shaped granite mass in northern Alexander County, considered the southern edge of the Brushy Mountains; summit stands roughly 600 ft above surrounding terrain. Max elevation cited around 1800 ft. A former granite quarry (operated 1920s) is on the mountain, with vertical walls rising 80+ ft.

facts.name: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area (OSM mapped area)
facts.what: Alexander County park (~318 acres). OpenStreetMap Nominatim centroid for the named recreation area.
facts.access: County park with parking lot and trailheads off Rocky Face Church Road

facts.name: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area (OSM bounding box)
facts.what: Geographic extent of the OSM-mapped recreation area (south,north,west,east). Roughly 1.16 km N-S by ~0.83 km E-W.

facts.name: Park entrance / address
facts.what: Official address of Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area: 3451 Rocky Face Church Road, Hiddenite, NC 28636. Park phone 828-632-1093. Hours 8am-5pm. Roughly 30 minutes from Statesville, NC.
facts.coords: approx 35.968,-81.111 (within mapped park; precise address node not geocoded by Nominatim)
facts.access: Main vehicular entrance; private/park lot parking near climbing area and restrooms

facts.name: Park acreage
facts.what: Total size of Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area; commonly cited as approximately 318 acres (some sources ~320). On the NC Registry of Natural Heritage Areas. Opened as a county park in 2013; site of a 1920s granite quarry.

facts.name: Trail system total mileage
facts.what: Overall hiking trail network. Most-cited figure: ~6 miles of hiking trails leading to the summit; some sources say 'nearly 5 miles' or 'over 5 miles'. Plus a separate 1/3-mile (0.3 mi) paved ADA walking track in the former quarry area. Park lists a total of 7 trails.
facts.access: Trails depart from main parking/trailhead area

facts.name: Buzzard Loop Trail
facts.what: Shortest hiking loop (purple blaze) near the park entrance; climbs ~100 ft to an overlook. Hollow Rock Trail ends at Buzzard Loop at the start of the quarry-overlook section, which follows the wire fence along the cliff edge.

facts.name: Walking Track (paved)
facts.what: Paved, ADA-accessible walking track (black blaze) located in the former quarry area.

facts.name: Hollow Rock Trail
facts.what: Lollipop-shaped trail (red blaze) - relatively gradual climb to the southwestern end of the ridge, runs the full length of the ridge top, loops around Rocky Face's peak, returns on the same trail. AllTrails lists a longer variant at 3.1 mi.
facts.elevation: 2.5 mi round trip (park); ~688 ft gain (AllTrails 3.1 mi variant)

facts.name: Vertical Mile Challenge Trail
facts.what: Strenuous trail (blue blaze) featuring a steep, exposed ~350-ft climb up an open granite face over ~0.3 mi, with no assistance/handholds. Combined Vertical Mile / Grindstone / Hollow Rock / Prison Camp loop has the most cumulative gain.
facts.elevation: 2.2 mi loop; ~350 ft granite-face climb. Combined route est. 3.8 mi / ~967 ft gain (AllTrails)
facts.access: From main trailhead; steep granite section

facts.name: Former granite quarry / climbing cliff
facts.what: Old rock quarry with vertical walls rising more than 80 ft; sheer rock cliff face with 60+ established bolted sport-climb routes (also top-ropeable). Operated as a quarry in the 1920s. Loose rock sheds regularly; helmets advised.
facts.access: Close to parking lot and restrooms

facts.name: Rocky Face Quarry Prospect (mindat locality)
facts.what: Mineralogical locality 'Rocky Face Quarry Prospect' at Hiddenite, Alexander County, NC, cataloged by mindat.org.

facts.name: General locality (Hiddenite, NC)
facts.what: Rocky Face Mountain sits just outside Hiddenite in northern/central Alexander County. Hiddenite coordinates 35.90528,-81.08611; elevation ~1093-1160 ft. County seat Taylorsville is nearby.
facts.access: Reached via Rocky Face Church Road off routes near Hiddenite
